correctness.rationale: For any presentation-computable external constants S, an element uniquely definable over a finite tuple from S is computable: formula-event probabilities evaluate distance 1-d(f,a), and an effective dense search approximates it. Finite elementary diagrams establish dcl_M(S)=Fix(Aut(M) pointwise stabilizing S). Conversely, from standard computable rational-interval presentation, twist fibers by each automorphism in the stabilizer on disjoint Borel intervals having one noncomputable relative measure alpha. Transporting the names preserves all computable abstract metric/formula/event data, while an original constant moved by any stabilizer element has a noncomputable preimage whose equality event reveals alpha; fixed constants remain computable. Therefore exactly definably closed S occur; the pure-set q cardinality gap and finite awareness/rigidity conclusions follow. Independent enumeration of pointwise stabilizers and fixed sets for q=1..6 corroborated finite group subclaim. No computable transport relative to a fixed standard presentation is asserted.
